name: spawnenv
description: libfgx's spawnv passes the current environment (environ, as 2.11BSD's pdp/sys/execv.s does): FGXENV is set with setenv(3) after exec, so it exists only in environ, and a spawnv'd sh must echo it; then spawnvp finds echo along PATH. Control: the old behaviour, spawnv passing libc's exec-time env block, prints 'child FGXENV=' with nothing after it, which this test calls red -- it discriminates because the variable is absent from the exec-time block by construction.
